title: ERR-4012: Rate limit exceeded
text: The client exceeded its token-bucket rate limit. The response is HTTP 429 and includes a Retry-After header. Back off exponentially before retrying.

title: ERR-4031: Webhook signature invalid
text: The X-Lumen-Signature header did not match the HMAC of the request body. Check the webhook secret and make sure the raw request body is used for verification.

title: ERR-4090: Idempotency key conflict
text: The Idempotency-Key was reused with a different request body. Use a new key for a new request.

title: ERR-5003: Model backend unavailable
text: The model backend could not serve the request, for example because inference workers are restarting or overloaded. Retry with backoff; persistent errors indicate an incident.

title: ERR-5040: Batch job timed out
text: A batch inference job did not finish within 24 hours and was marked FAILED. Split large inputs into smaller jobs.
